ch11-returning-books.en: Open Library and Issue / Return, then the Return Book tab.
Search by the borrower or the book title.
Press Process Return, and check the summary.
Press Confirm Return. The copy goes back on the shelf, and the loan leaves the list.
Search for a late borrower. The summary shows the days overdue and the fine.
Confirm the return. The fine is calculated for you and recorded on the loan.
ch11-setting-up-book-categories.en: Open Library and Catalog, then press Manage Categories.
Type the category name and a short description.
Press Add Category, and it appears in the list below.
Press Edit next to a category to change its name or description, then Save Changes.
Press Done. The categories now appear in the catalog filter and the Add Book form.
ch11-tracking-overdue-books.en: Let's keep track of overdue books.
The tiles show the overdue books, the fines so far, and the fine per day.
Each row shows the borrower, the due date, the days overdue and the fine. The oldest loans come first.
Press Return on a row and confirm. The fine is recorded, and the loan leaves the overdue list.
ch12-creating-assignments.en: Open Academics, then Assignments, and press Create Assignment.
Enter the title, then choose the class, the subject and the teacher.
Set the due date and the total marks.
Write the description, which is required, and the instructions for students.
Press Create Assignment. It starts as a Draft.
Press Publish so students can see it in their portal.
ch12-creating-lesson-plans.en: Open Planning and Delivery, then Lesson Plans.
Press Add Lesson Plan, then Create single lesson plan. Choose Standard for the full details.
Enter the title, then choose the class, the subject and the teacher.
Press Select chapter or topic, tick a topic from the book, and press Apply.
Set the lesson date and write an objective.
Leave the status as Draft and press Create Lesson Plan. To see it, choose the class and the lesson date.
Press Publish on the plan to share it.
ch12-managing-curriculum-books-chapters-: Choose the class and the subject, and the books for them are listed.
Press Add Book. Choose the class and subject, enter the title and the edition, then press Add Book again.
The book is created and listed.
Click the book to see its chapters.
Press Add Chapter, enter the title, and save it.
Open the chapter and press Add Topic. Enter the title and save it.
For a whole book, press Import Table of Contents. On the Manual Entry tab, you type or paste the chapters and topics.
ch12-reviewing-submissions.en: Open Assignments, and click the number in the Submissions column.
Press Grade, enter the marks and some feedback, and press Save.
A graded submission can be sent back to the student with Return.
ch13-creating-notification-templates-adm: Open Notifications and switch to the Templates tab.
Press New Template, type a name, choose the event, and write the message. Placeholders use double braces.
Press Save, and the template is now ready to use when you send.
Search for it and press Preview to see the message with sample values.
ch13-sending-notifications-admin.en: Open Notifications and switch to the Send tab. Broadcast to Group is selected.
Choose a template to fill in the title and message.
Choose the group, here All Teachers. The channel stays In-App.
Press Review and Send Broadcast, check the number of recipients, and press Confirm Send.
ch13-viewing-notifications-all-users.en: Open Notifications in the sidebar. New ones are listed under Today.
Use the All Types list to see only one kind, for example Fee due.
Switch back to All Types and tick Unread only to hide what you have read.
Press Mark all read and confirm, to clear everything at once.
ch14-replying-to-messages.en: Open Messages. Unread conversations show a number. Click one to read it.
Type your reply in the box at the bottom.
Press Enter, or the arrow button, to send. Your message appears on the right.
ch14-starting-a-new-conversation.en: Open Messages in the sidebar and press New Message.
Open the To box, search for a name and pick the person.
Add a subject if you like, then type your message.
Press Send Message, and the conversation opens on the right.
ch15-applying-for-leave.en: Let's apply for leave for your child.
Click Leave Requests in the sidebar. The Apply for Leave tab opens first.
Choose the child, then enter the start date and the end date.
Write the reason. A link to a supporting document is optional.
Press Submit Leave Request. A green message confirms it was sent to the school.
Open My Requests. The new request is Pending. Earlier ones show the school's decision and remarks.
